name: Mottled Prominent
desc: Mottled Prominent (Macrurocampa marthesia): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 12 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Macrurocampa marthesia, commonly known as the mottled prominent, is a species of prominent moth in the family Notodontidae. It was described by Pieter Cramer in 1780 and is found in North America.
